hle_md5_basic.description:
This endpoint validates requests with MAC = md5(secret || data) where secret is unknown. Perform a length extension attack to append data without knowing the secret.
known_hash=d2cd6c5950f33417008a43f9e444c5fe
known_message=user=guest
append=;role=admin
secret_length=26
hle_md5_basic.note: MD5(secret||data) 长度扩展，secret 未知，伪造含 role=admin 的 MAC
